policy.lecture: Lecture slides define current scope and exam-priority vocabulary.
policy.exercise: Homework solutions define practice and derivation depth; they do not silently expand lecture scope.
policy.textbook: The course textbook is represented as a chapter pointer index only; raw textbook pages are not copied into the public bundle.
policy.reference: Optional or externally supplied material must be labeled and cannot upgrade a topic into lecture scope.
policy.sourceLayer: Original PDFs remain local. Normalized extraction preserves sourceId, page, block type, bounding box, imageId, and parser reference.
